Unit 1 · Short Vowel a
1 Words and Pictures (Tracks 01–02)
Listen, repeat, and say.
ham, ram, dam, jam, lap, map, cap, nap

A Listen and repeat. (Track 03)
h-am, ham. r-am, ram. d-am, dam. j-am, jam.
c-ap, cap. l-ap, lap. m-ap, map. n-ap, nap.

B Read the word and circle the right picture.
1 dam
2 map
3 ram
4 nap
5 jam
6 cap

C Write the name of the shadow.
Use the words in the box: lap, map, nap, cap, ham, dam, jam, ram
Example: ram

D Listen and circle the right picture. (Track 04)
Eight rows of three pictures: listen to the word and circle the picture you hear.

E Listen and fill in the circle. (Track 05)
Choose the sentence you hear. Sight words: the, has, a, is
1 A ram has a ham. / A ram has a jam.
2 A cap is on a ram. / A cap is on a dam.
3 The dam has a ham. / The dam has a ram.
4 The map has a cap. / The map has a jam.

F Find and circle the words.
The words go across and down: jam, map, nap, ham, cap, lap, dam, ram
g r o j g f
l a p a z n
h m c m x z
a d a m a p
m g p n a p

G Circle the word that completes the sentence. Then write the word on the line.
1 The ram is on the ___. (dam, ham, jam)
2 The ram has a ___. (lap, cap, map)
3 The ___ is on the map. (ham, cap, jam)
4 The map is on the ___. (lap, nap, cap)
5 The cap is on the ___. (map, lap, nap)
I finished Unit 1! Teacher stamp or sticker

Audio and Credits
Listen: this book has 55 audio tracks (MP3). The track number in each headphone tag, for example Track 07, matches the file name Book2_Track07.mp3. Find the files in the Audio folder of your download. Play them on any phone, tablet or computer, as often as you like. Press play, listen, pause, then answer. Most tracks are played twice. No audio yet? Teachers can read the scripts aloud from the Teacher's Guide. (Track 18 is not used; the numbering is kept so the other tracks match the book.)

Jurassic English Phonics
Book 2 · Short Vowels
Jurassic English Phonics is a five-book series that helps young learners read and spell English with confidence.
In Book 2, children learn the short vowel sounds a, e, i, o and u through themed units, chants, games and stories.
8 themed units, 2 review units and a Challenge · Listening tracks, word games and picture stories · A test and key vocabulary list at the back
The series: Book 1, Book 2, Book 3, Book 4, Book 5
by Matthew Goslee · WorldWise Learning · www.jurassicenglish.com
